marta-ux: Quick design review — can we look at the Private Setup wizard? Main focus: networking step order, prereq checks, copy polish, and a11y nits. Hoping to keep this short. samir-pm: Yep, can do. Biggest product risk is users getting stuck during network preflight. We should aim to make failures actionable, not just 'X failed'. natalie-design: Agreed. Current label 'Network preflight' reads as engineering jargon. Suggest 'Connectivity checks' or 'Network & firewall checks' for clarity. :memo: cheng-eng: +1 on naming. Also a technical note: the preflight currently blocks the next step until it completes (~20–40s). Can we run it async and let users continue with a clear warning badge? That would reduce perceived latency. marta-ux: Proposed step order to discuss: 1) Prereqs summary (single-line bullets with quick links) 2) Connectivity checks (run async, show streaming status) 3) IP & routing config (user picks subnets / CIDR) 4) Final validation + save & download config Does that feel right? samir-pm: Looks right. Also think we should surface a 'skip for now' for advanced infra teams with a tooltip explaining risks. natalie-design: UI / copy suggestions — paste below. Trying to keep microcopy short and scannable. ``` Step header: Connectivity checks Description: We will run a quick set of network checks to ensure your VPC can reach Redwood's inference endpoints. This runs in the background — you can continue setup and review results later. Status labels: • Checking • Warning — action required • Failed — details available • Passed Action button (failed): View diagnostics Accessibility notes: • Add aria-live="polite" to the status stream so screen readers hear updates. • Use high-contrast state colors and include icon + text (not color only). ``` cheng-eng: For implementation, recommend using a streaming websocket for status lines and a separate final validation call. Also add these ARIA snippets: ```
Connectivity: Checking...
Opens a panel with firewall rules and suggested fixes ``` natalie-design: A11y nit — avoid 'Passed' vs 'Failed' icons that rely on shape alone. Use labels like 'Connectivity OK' and 'Connectivity blocked' and ensure focus moves to the first failed item when diagnostics open. ops-bot: preflight-checker: sample log snippet: ``` [00:00] ping 10.0.0.1 -> success [00:01] egress 443 -> timeout [00:01] suggested fix: allow egress to *.redwood.ai:443 ``` marta-ux: Good example. Copy tweak: change button 'Retry checks' -> 'Re-run connectivity checks' (more explicit). samir-pm: UX question: do we collapse non-critical warnings by default? Eg TLS versions mismatch is a warning but not blocking. natalie-design: Yes, collapse with a 'Show all warnings' link. Keep primary screen focused on blocking failures. cheng-eng: Dev note: when a non-blocking warning exists, surface it inline with an info icon and a short explanation + link to docs. For blocking failures, default to expanding the diagnostics panel and set keyboard focus to the first actionable control. marta-ux: I'll update the Figma frames and add copy variants for localization. Action items: 1) natalie — update copy + labels; 2) cheng — prototype async status + aria; 3) samir — confirm skip/advanced flow and what we log for support. samir-pm: Thanks — I'll write the acceptance criteria and small PRD. natalie-design: Will do, aim to post updated artboard by EOD. :racehorse: marta-ux: Thanks all — moving this to a short follow-up review tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
